derivationCodes.AI: Analytical data; from the literature or  government;  incomplete documentation
derivationCodes.AR: Analytical data; derived by linear regression
derivationCodes.BFCN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Carbohydrate; Retention factors not used
derivationCodes.BFFN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Fat; Retention factors not used
derivationCodes.BFNN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Non-fat solids; Retention factors not used
derivationCodes.BFPN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Protein; Retention factors not used
derivationCodes.BFSN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Solids; Retention factors not used
derivationCodes.BFYN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Yield; Retention factors not used
derivationCodes.BFZN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; No adjustment; Retention factors not used
derivationCodes.CAZN: Calculated from different food; From average values for food category; No adjustment; Retention factors not used
derivationCodes.FLA: Estimated formulation based on ingredient list; Linear program used to estimate ingredients; Analytical data
derivationCodes.FLC: Estimated formulation based on ingredient list; Linear program used to estimate ingredients; Claim on label/serving
derivationCodes.JA: Aggregated data involving combinations of data with only source codes 1 and 12 and/or 13
derivationCodes.JO: Aggregated data involving combinations of data with different source codes when at least one code is not 1, 6, 12, or 13
derivationCodes.LC: Label claim (back calculated from label by NDL staff; Calculated from label claim/serving (g or %RDI)
derivationCodes.MA: Manufacturer supplied(industry or trade association), Analytical data, incomplete documentation
derivationCodes.MC: Manufacturer supplied; Calculated by manufacturer or unknown if analytical or calculated
derivationCodes.NR: Nutrient that is based on other nutrient/s; value used directly, ex. Nut.#204 from Nut.#298
derivationCodes.RA: Recipe; Approximate ingredient proportions (ex. combination of several recipes)
derivationCodes.RKI: Recipe;Known formulation;No adjustments applied, combination of source codes which includes codes other than 1,12,or 6
derivationCodes.S: Product standard, such as enrichment level specified in CFR or AMS commodity standard
derivationCodes.T: Taken from another source--other tables of food composition
derivationCodes.Z: Assumed zero (Insignificant amount or not naturally occurring in a food, such as fiber in meat)
